summary: Autonomous-auto under-budgeted campaign strategy when completed-loop freshness checks overrode a fresh research-to-readiness approval. The router treated old campaign completion as terminal even for a new research-only strategy candidate, and recommendation packets lacked lifecycle-route/preflight evidence.
lesson: Separate current_loop_authority from fresh_campaign_authority before init or open-next. A completed green loop remains non-continuation authority, but a fresh research_to_readiness approval can route a live candidate to research_initiative with campaign_strategy_preflight while hydrate_task, ship_task, and open_next_without_strategy_preflight stay blocked.
applied_changes: Added campaign_strategy_preflight route state for fresh research-to-readiness strategy candidates.
Added initiative route_preflight evidence to next-campaign recommendation packets and draft declarations.
Attached lifecycle route decisions to discovered initiative research decisions so operator-read exposes route authority.
Kept lifecycle-report preflight read-only and avoided recursive recommendation generation.
verification: python3 scripts/run_ledger.py status -> no active run; shared write claim none
residual_risk: strategy_preflight_required currently uses conservative readiness wording markers: strategy, preflight, or open_next. Future slices should prefer structured readiness fields if this pattern repeats.
recommended_follow_on: When opening future autonomous-auto campaigns, require recommendation packets and declarations to display route_preflight.verdict, selected_route, route_state, approval_scope, and blocked_alternatives before any init/open-next edge.
